# Icon

## 설치

```bash
yarn add @wanteddev/wds-icon
```

## 목록

<Demo 
  hideCode
  code={`import { FlexBox, useToast } from '@wanteddev/wds';
import * as Icons from '@wanteddev/wds-icon';
import copy from 'copy-to-clipboard';

const Demo = () => {
  const toast = useToast();

  const handleClick = (value) => () => {
    const success = copy(value);

		if (success) {
			toast({
				variant: 'success',
				content: '클립보드에 복사 했습니다.',
			});
		}
  }

  return (
    <FlexBox flexWrap="wrap" gap="12px">
      {Object.entries(Icons).map(([name, Component]) => (
        <FlexBox
				  as="button"
          css={theme => ({ 
					  backgroundColor: theme.palette.background.elevated.alternative,
						borderRadius: '4px',
						fontSize: '32px',
            height: '48px',
						width: '48px',
						color: theme.palette.label.normal,
						cursor: 'pointer',
					})}
          alignItems="center"
          justifyContent="center"
          name={name}
          key={name}
					onClick={handleClick(name)}
        >
          <Component />
        </FlexBox>
      ))}
    </FlexBox>
  )
}

export default Demo;`}
/>
